ruling.recommended_action: Send to Ryde Trust & Safety: review the chat threat against the rider, contact both parties, and confirm whether police report / RydeHELP safety report was filed; apply code-of-conduct action per SAFE-1 as appropriate. No fare action needed (metered fare within optimal-route distance).
ruling.escalation_reason: Confirmed threat of physical violence in the chat record: rider's 18:22 message “Say that again and I will punch you.” [F4] in reply to the driver's no-smoking request at 18:21 [F3], matching the driver's safety complaint [F6]. Substantive route/overcharge questions are moot — the metered trip was 8.8 km actual vs 8.9 km optimal route (-0.1 km, -1%) [F1] over 13.3 min vs 16 min estimated [F2], so no off-route segment exists and no fare adjustment arises.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider advocate's request for no_action fails on the record: the rider's own timestamped message “Say that again and I will punch you.” [F4] is a threat of violence against the driver, which Ryde's code of conduct bars and which requires escalation rather than an automatic no_action outcome [SAFE-1].

Driver advocate likewise requested no_action; a no_action disposition would close a confirmed safety complaint without human review, contrary to the mandatory escalation required for threats/intimidation in the chat record [SAFE-1] read with [F4] and [F6].
